# Call Forwarding — Germany (TeleNord)

This guide covers unconditional and conditional call forwarding for Northwind DE customers whose landline is provided by the fictional carrier **TeleNord**.

## Activation codes
- Unconditional (all calls): dial `*21*<destination number>#` and wait for the confirmation tone.
- On no reply (after ~20s): `*61*<destination number>#`.
- On busy: `*67*<destination number>#`.
- Deactivate all forwarding: `##002#`.

## Notes
- The destination should be the Northwind DE service number assigned to the customer.
- If the customer reports that forwarding does not engage, confirm the line is not already forwarded elsewhere with `*#21#`.

# Desvío de llamadas — España (IberLink)

Guía de configuración del desvío de llamadas para clientes de Northwind ES cuya línea fija está operada por el operador ficticio **IberLink**.

## Códigos de activación
- Desvío incondicional (todas las llamadas): marque `*21*<número de destino>#`.
- Desvío si no contesta: `*61*<número de destino>#`.
- Desvío si está ocupado: `*67*<número de destino>#`.
- Cancelar todos los desvíos: `##002#`.

## Notas
- El número de destino debe ser el número de servicio de Northwind ES asignado al cliente.
- Para comprobar el estado del desvío incondicional: `*#21#`.

# Renvoi d'appel — France (Rhonecom)

Configuration du renvoi d'appel pour les clients Northwind FR dont la ligne est fournie par l'opérateur fictif **Rhonecom**.

## Codes
- Renvoi inconditionnel : `*21*<numéro de destination>#`.
- Renvoi sur non-réponse : `*61*<numéro de destination>#`.
- Renvoi sur occupation : `*67*<numéro de destination>#`.
- Désactiver tous les renvois : `#21#`.

## Remarques
- Le numéro de destination est le numéro de service Northwind FR du client.

# Call Forwarding — Overview

Northwind Contact Solutions answers calls on behalf of customers across several markets. Before a customer's calls reach a Northwind agent, the customer must forward their own line to the Northwind service number.

## The three common modes
- **Unconditional** — every call is forwarded immediately. Used when Northwind fully handles the line.
- **On no reply** — the customer's phone rings first, then forwards after a delay.
- **On busy** — forwards only when the customer's line is engaged.

Carrier-specific activation codes are documented per country (see the Germany, Spain and France guides). When a code does not work, verify the customer's carrier — codes differ between operators.
